purpose: Replace the visually strange, bottom-heavy V36 Daily-down gloss with a cute, gentle lowered-attention endpoint.

reference.usage: The locked V9 image is the sole generator reference. All earlier V36 down attempts remain audit history and are not prompt inputs.

output_contract.format: one unlabelled 200x200-equivalent V9 Daily-down source face
output_contract.pixel_intent: clean monochrome black ink on plain white; no grey, colour, texture or shading
output_contract.allowed_change: only the enclosed white large glossy oval and small four-point companion sparkle inside each existing open black eye silhouette
output_contract.down_geometry: the V9 vertically elongated primary oval and its small diamond remain one close group, settle modestly below rest around the middle-to-lower-middle band, never enter the bottom third, and retain a broad continuous black lower rim; the diamond sits adjacent on the lower-inner side
protected_identity: V9 outer black eye silhouette, placement and scale

forbidden: new outer eye silhouette, eye size or eye placement
new brow, mouth, cheek or charm art
legacy art, custom LUT, code-drawn eye, activation, provisioning or firmware flash
required_machine_gates_before_use: native-200 down distinction without bottom-heavy morphology
